text:
sam: Morning — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 2026-03-18 17:00 PT. Please post any backport / cherry-pick asks here by EOD today. Only critical bugfixes, docs, or release tooling changes will be considered.

lia: Quick Q — what's the version bump string? Are we doing 1.16.0 or 1.16.0-rc in the branch? Also what's the changelog format you want?

sam: We'll bump to 1.16.0 on the main release. The branch is release/1.16. Use the standard changelog fragment format: `scope: short description (PR #)` — drop files in docs/changelog/unreleased/1.16/.

kavita: @sam requesting a cherry-pick: PR #3892 — nil-pointer in KV cache on cold start, test added. It fixes prod NPE. Can someone help resolve the conflict if it pops up?

sam: Yes. Process: open a cherrypick PR against release/1.16, include the original commit SHA in the body, add label `cherry-pick/request`, and once CI passes add `cherry-pick/approved`. Criteria: small surface change, tests included, no new feature flags. If you hit conflicts tag me or @oliver.

release-bot: CI status — PR #4002 (cherry-pick for #3892) build: passed :white_check_mark:

oliver: What's the cutoff for new features? We have the perf opt in flight that touches batching.

sam: Cutoff for features is 12 hours before cut. We should avoid landing perf changes that can affect latency unless it's behind a flag and we have a rollback plan. For exceptions open a Release Exception ticket with: risk, rollback steps, and test plan.

kavita: Working commands (for visibility):
```
# from local branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b cherrypick/3892 origin/release/1.16
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, run tests
git push origin HEAD:cherrypick/3892
```

sam: :thumbsup: Also add a changelog fragment under docs/changelog/unreleased/1.16/ and mention the PR in the fragment. Lia — can you tidy the changelog after the final set of cherrypicks?

lia: :eyes: Yep, I can collate fragments and run the release notes script after cut.

oliver: Heads up — tagging QA and perf for validation: @qa @perf-team. We should run a quick smoke and perf run after branch creation.

sam: I'll run the smoke deploy and perf baseline once cut is done. If anyone needs manual validation, ping me and I'll queue you in the slot.

release-bot: deploy-bot: cut-branch scheduled: release/1.16 at 2026-03-18T17:00:00-07:00 (automated job queued)

kavita: Thanks — will open the cherry-pick PR now.

lia: LGTM

oliver: Noted, thanks everyone.
